title: Where the Dead Were Sent
summary: Cross the ruined portal with Amar, follow the plague dead into the Nether, and search a fossil field for the last proof that Amar was ever meant to have a grave.
offer_intro_line: Amar examines the ruined portal as though it were a badly maintained cemetery gate.

offer_dialogue_steps.line: No. Want has very little to do with funerary work.
A marked token, most likely iron or brass. Undertakers tied them to unclaimed bodies when names could not be trusted to paper.

offer_dialogue_steps.choice: What if there is nothing left?
offer_dialogue_steps.line: Then I will have travelled to the Nether to confirm that my paperwork was destroyed. It would not be my worst professional day.
I intend to. You are, at present, my only living witness.

objectives.completion_dialogue_line: Bones. Too many to count, which has never stopped anyone from making me try.

quest_book.title: Red Sand Disposal Roll
quest_book.author: Qasra Disposal Crew
pages:
WESTERN GATE DISPOSAL ROLL

Batch 14. Twenty-three bodies. Fourteen marked.
Batch 15. Thirty-one bodies. Nine marked. Gate unstable. Two wrappings lost to fire.
Batch 16. Amar ibn Sahl. Undertaker. Guild token attached at left wrist. Diamond shovel left with body by order of foreman.
Foreman objected to retaining the shovel. Crew refused to remove it.
Body passed through alone after the final cart.

threats.name: Bone Collector
threats.target_line: The dead here have had enough hands laid on them.

return_dialogue_line: I found my entry. I found the place. I even found men who remembered enough to leave me my shovel. I did not find what I came for.

return_dialogue_steps.line: Yes. That observation has become increasingly difficult to ignore.

return_dialogue_steps.choice: Then what were you looking for?
return_dialogue_steps.line: Proof that someone had noticed I was gone.
They left the shovel. I thought that was carelessness. It appears I have been insulting dead men for a century.
Yes. But I no longer think it is meant to hold me.
To mark the fact that Amar the Undertaker died. What happens to Amar afterward may be a separate administrative matter.

reward_dialogue_line: Take nothing from that place. The dead there have been handled enough.
already_completed_line: The Nether kept the bones. I kept the name. I consider that an acceptable division.
